script.speaker: student
script.text: Can I book a study room for tomorrow afternoon?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The small rooms are full. There is one big room at three.

script.speaker: student
script.text: We are only two people. Is that a problem?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: No, but bring your card and be on time. We keep it fifteen minutes.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Okay, three o'clock. Thank you.

question.stem: When can they use a room?
question.explain_tr: Küçük odalar dolu; yarın saat üçte büyük oda boş.
question.key_line: There is one big room at three.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I have an appointment on Tuesday, but I have an exam.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: I can move you to Thursday at four.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Thursday is good. Do I pay again?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: No, you keep the same appointment. Just come ten minutes early.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Fine. Thursday at four, ten minutes early.

question.stem: What must the student do on Thursday?
question.explain_tr: Ücret tekrar alınmıyor; sadece on dakika erken gelmesi isteniyor.

script.speaker: student
script.text: My bus card doesn't work. The machine says zero.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: You can load money here or with the phone app.

script.speaker: student
script.text: The app didn't work for me last week.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then load it here. Fifty lira is enough for two weeks.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Okay, fifty lira, please.

question.stem: How does the student load the card?
question.explain_tr: Uygulama geçen hafta çalışmadığı için parayı gişede yüklüyor.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I was ill on Monday. Can I see your notes?

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Sure, but my handwriting is terrible.

script.speaker: student
script.text: That's fine. Was there any homework?

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Yes, two pages for Friday. And the teacher changed the exam date.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Changed it? To when?

script.speaker: friend
script.text: To the week after. Check the group message.

question.stem: What does the student learn about the exam?

options.B: It moved to a later week

question.explain_tr: Sınav bir hafta sonraya alınmış. Cuma tarihi ödev için söyleniyor.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Is this bike still for sale?

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Yes. Nine hundred lira, but the back light is broken.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Can you fix it before Saturday?

script.speaker: friend
script.text: A new light is fifty lira. I can put it on tonight.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Then nine hundred and fifty, with the light. Deal.

options.A: The student pays nine hundred lira
options.B: The student pays for the bike and the new light

question.explain_tr: Kırık lamba yenisiyle değişiyor ve fiyat elli lira artıyor.
question.key_line: Then nine hundred and fifty, with the light.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Two tickets for the eight o'clock film, please.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Are you students? Then it is half price on Wednesday.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Today is Tuesday.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then it is full price, one hundred lira for two.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: We come tomorrow then. Same film, same time?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, but book early. Wednesday is busy.

question.stem: Why do they decide to come back tomorrow?

options.B: Students pay half price on Wednesday
options.D: They have no money at all

question.explain_tr: Öğrenci indirimi çarşamba geçerli; bugün salı olduğu için tam ücret isteniyor.
question.key_line: Then it is half price on Wednesday.

script.speaker: student
script.text: There is a package for me, but I was in class.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The driver comes again tomorrow between ten and twelve.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I have class until eleven.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then leave a note. Your neighbour can take it for you.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Good idea. I write the note now.

question.stem: What does the staff member suggest?

options.B: Asking a neighbour to take the package

question.explain_tr: Öğrenci on bire kadar derste olduğu için komşusunun paketi almasını öneriyor.
question.key_line: Your neighbour can take it for you.

script.speaker: student
script.text: My phone screen is broken. How long does the repair take?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Normally two days, but we don't have this screen now.

script.speaker: student
script.text: When do you get it?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: On Friday. So your phone is ready on Monday.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Monday is late, but okay.

question.stem: When will the phone be ready?
question.explain_tr: Ekran cuma geliyor, telefon pazartesi hazır. İki gün ise normal onarım süresi.
question.key_line: So your phone is ready on Monday.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I want to join the photography club. Is there a fee?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Fifty lira for the year. The first meeting is free.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Can I come once and decide later?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Of course. Come on Thursday at six and see.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Thursday at six. I bring my camera.

question.stem: What does the student decide to do?

options.B: Go to the free first meeting

question.explain_tr: İlk toplantı ücretsiz; öğrenci önce gelip görmeyi seçiyor.
question.key_line: Can I come once and decide later?

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Are we going to the lake on Saturday?

script.speaker: student
script.text: The weather is bad on Saturday. Sunday is sunny.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: I work on Sunday morning until one.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Then we go in the afternoon. The bus leaves at two.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Perfect. I meet you at the stop at half past one.

question.stem: When do they go to the lake?
question.explain_tr: Cumartesi hava kötü, pazar sabahı arkadaş çalışıyor; geriye pazar öğleden sonrası kalıyor.
question.key_line: Then we go in the afternoon.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Why is my printing so expensive this month?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: You print one page on each sheet. Double-sided costs less.

script.speaker: student
script.text: How do I change that?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: In the print window, choose both sides before you send it.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Both sides. I try it now.

question.stem: How can the student pay less?
question.explain_tr: Tek yüze basmak pahalıya geliyor; çift taraflı baskı daha ucuz.

script.speaker: student
script.text: The heating in my room doesn't work.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Which floor? The third floor had a problem yesterday.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I am on the third floor, room nineteen.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The technician comes tomorrow morning. Tonight I can give you a heater.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Yes, please. It is really cold.

question.stem: What does the student get tonight?
question.explain_tr: Tesisatçı yarın sabah geliyor; bu gece için ısıtıcı veriliyor.
question.key_line: Tonight I can give you a heater.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I want an English speaking partner. How does it work?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: You meet once a week for an hour. Half English, half Turkish.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Do I choose the person?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: We match you by your level and your free days.

script.speaker: student
script.text: My free day is Wednesday.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then write Wednesday on the form.

question.explain_tr: Eşleştirme seviyeye ve boş günlere göre yapılıyor; kişiyi öğrenci seçmiyor.
question.key_line: We match you by your level and your free days.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Do you have this grammar book?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Not now, but I can order it. It comes in three days.

script.speaker: student
script.text: My exam is in two days.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then take the library copy. You can keep it for one week.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Good. Where is the library copy?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Second floor, English section.

question.explain_tr: Kitap üç günde geliyor ama sınav iki gün sonra; bu yüzden kütüphane kopyası alınıyor.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Can I change my train ticket to the evening train?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, but there is a small fee. Twenty lira.

script.speaker: student
script.text: And if I cancel?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then you lose half the money. Changing is cheaper.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Okay, I change it. The seven o'clock train.

question.stem: Why does the student change the ticket instead of cancelling it?

options.D: The staff member refuses to cancel

question.explain_tr: İptalde paranın yarısı gidiyor, değişiklik yirmi lira; değiştirmek daha ucuz.
question.key_line: Then you lose half the money. Changing is cheaper.

script.speaker: student
script.text: How many hours do volunteers work every week?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Three hours. Most students come on Saturday morning.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I can't come on Saturday. I work in a shop.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: There is a small group on Tuesday evening too.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Tuesday evening is perfect for me.

question.explain_tr: Cumartesi dükkânda çalıştığı için salı akşamı grubunu seçiyor.
question.key_line: There is a small group on Tuesday evening too.
